authorization: User requested completion of the combined checklist, including training; pause on hardware problems. User selected provisional AI image scoring, human review later.
corpus: 363192 conservative kingdom+binomial taxonomy records from released TreeOfLife-10M species list, preserving all5388 pilot rows. This is not verified TaxaAdapter TreeOfLife-1M training membership.
embedding: Frozen BioCLIP2 raw768-dimensional output from space-separated full taxonomy; no normalization before TaxaAdapter

conditional_sweep.trigger: No primary SAE feature passes unchanged recurrence gate
conditional_sweep.selection: Report all configurations. Prefer primary if passing; otherwise greatest number of passing features, then lower validation NMSE, then smaller width and k. Test reconstruction is descriptive only.

recurrence_gate: For each anchor coordinate, best signed activation correlation across training species selects a match in each replicate. Require training r>=0.7 AND signed cosine of that same decoder pair>=0.7 in all five replicates. Report collisions; no sign flips or threshold relaxation.
trait_benchmark: Separate prespecified AVONET beak length/depth endpoint and CPU ridge-vs-taxonomy control. Its protocol is in ../trait_benchmark_v1/protocol.json. Positive prediction does not by itself validate an SAE feature or image intervention.

candidate_selection.independent_label_endpoint: Natural log of AVONET beak length from nares divided by depth
candidate_selection.eligibility: Passing SAE recurrence gate; positive activity in at least30 labelled training birds from at least10 genera and3 families
candidate_selection.ranking: Largest absolute Pearson correlation of training feature activation and measured trait after subtracting each training family's mean from both variables. Record ordinary correlations too. Select one candidate without validation/test trait results.
candidate_selection.confirmation: Use validation birds only to check the preselected association direction with a2000-resample genus-cluster bootstrap95% interval excluding zero. This is exploratory validation because SAE checkpoints used validation reconstruction, and the raw-vector probe also uses these labels.
candidate_selection.failure: If no candidate satisfies these criteria, preserve the negative result and do not force a large image intervention study. Support-neighbor and bridge demonstrations may still be generated as representation exploration, without trait claims.

intervention_branch.prerequisites: Stable, independently labelled candidate plus measurable baseline image endpoint. Provisional AI scores are not human validation.
intervention_branch.pilot: One selected species, eight paired image seeds, fixed view prompt, original/reconstruction/residual-preserving removal/half/double/other-feature/matched-norm random controls. Define endpoint and blind scores before condition unblinding.
intervention_branch.replication: Only a promising interpretable pilot advances to32 fresh paired seeds and replication in a second species and independently trained SAE. Report missingness separately from zeros and biological changes separately from background/pose.
intervention_branch.edit: x_edited = x + decode(z_edited) - decode(z); edit one coordinate without reapplying TopK.

overlap_and_bridges: Exact binary support overlap, positive values only, exclude self, deterministic ties. Rank top10 neighbors for every expanded taxonomy record. A selected bridge changes one coordinate at a time and retains source residual, with raw endpoint references; its last edited vector need not equal the raw target vector.
human_review: Deferred by user; retain blank human annotation files and clearly separate provisional AI labels.
hardware: Single GPU owner; stop on OOM/CUDA failure, temperature>=88C or freeVRAM<2048MiB. No automatic hardware fallback or retry.
reporting: Archive protocols, input/output hashes, scripts, checkpoints, scores, exclusions and negative findings. Do not describe unrun conditional experiments as completed validation.
